rampThreshold.source: BNBC 2020 Part 3 Sec 1.2 'Ramp' (p. 44); Part 4 Sec 3.11.1 (p. 315): a ramp is steeper than 1 in 20

handrails.source: BNBC 2020 Part 3 Sec 1.2 'Ramp' (p. 44): a ramp shall have guard and handrail. Part 4 Sec 3.11.4 asks for them above 1 in 15 only; the Part 3 definition (every ramp) is the more conservative and is kept

notes.text: Level landings at the bottom and the top, at least as wide as the ramp; a landing at a door opening is at least 1525 mm long where the door swings onto it.
Changes of direction only at level landings.

handrails.source: BNBC 2020 Part 3 Sec 1.2 'Ramp' (p. 44): a ramp shall have guard and handrail. Part 4 Sec 3.11.4 asks for them above 1 in 15 only; the Part 3 definition (every ramp) is the more conservative and is kept

notes.text: Surfaced with approved non-slip material or finished to prevent slipping.
At least as wide as the corridors or passages the exit needs.
Level landings at the bottom and the top, at least as wide as the ramp; a landing at a door opening is at least 1525 mm long where the door swings onto it; no door opens onto the slope.
